files.html: //! robotgpu_sidebyside - the same robot, servoing the same motion, on two engines at once. //! //! LEFT, the CPU: robot.zig. RIGHT, the GPU: robotgpu, one world of the same model, given the same floor and the same //! servo law (`robot.servoTorques`, run by the device's kernels). Each frame both are given the same target and step //! once. The GPU's body poses are asked for after its step and drawn when they arrive, a frame or more later; its //! simulation never waits for them. The two engines compute the same functions, so the two robots move together. They //! part only as rounding accumulates: the GPU's arithmetic differs from the CPU's in its last bits, and a motion on the //! edge of falling lets those bits grow. //! //! THE SCENES, one at a time - the button in the lower left moves to the next; each is built when shown and released //! when left, so one GPU world exists at a time: //! //! Geno, the dance on the CPU the tracking task's own fleet (`robot_track.Fleet`, one character, Geno's //! `tracking_task`: his servo, floor and failure rule); on the GPU the decision program //! (`Sim.submitDecision`), the dance's frames on the device, each world's targets formed //! there from them. The servo alone, no action - so both aim a frame ahead at the same pose, //! hold a few seconds of the dance, fall, and start again together: when the fleet begins a new //! episode, the GPU's world begins it from exactly the fleet's new state. //! The Go1, standing dropped onto the floor and servoed to its home pose (the model's own keyframe), then dropped //! again - the CPU side robot.zig's servo step as `ServoRun` takes it (`CpuServo`). //! //! Standard wgpu example contract: a `pub const app: z.AppSpec(State)`. const std = @import("std"); const z = @import("zimr"); const zm = @import("zm"); const codecs = z.codecs; const rbt = z.robot; const mjcf = z.mjcf; const robot_mjcf = z.robot_mjcf; const dance = z.robot_dance; const geno = z.robot_geno; const track = z.robot_track; const wgpu = z.wgpu; const robotgpu = @import("robotgpu"); const robotgpu_host = @import("robotgpu_host"); const Allocator = std.mem.Allocator; const Color = zm.Color; const Camera3D = zm.Camera3D; const Vec = zm.Vec; const Vec2 = zm.Vec2; const Mat = zm.Mat; const Quat = zm.Quat; const Rectangle = z.Rectangle; const vec = zm.vec; const splat = zm.splat; const mulMat = zm.mulMat; const qmul = zm.qmul; const rotate = zm.rotate; const quatToMat = zm.quatToMat; const quatFromTo = zm.quatFromTo; const translation = zm.translation; const scaling = zm.scaling; const length3 = zm.length3; const assertf = zm.assertf; const Sim = robotgpu_host.Sim; const Pipe = robotgpu_host.Pipe; const PoseArrayRequest = Pipe.RangeRequest(.world_f); const atkinson_mono_ttf = @embedFile("atkinson_mono_ttf"); const bind_bvh = @embedFile("geno_bind.bvh"); const dance_bvh = @embedFile("dance1_20s.bvh"); /// The engine's z-up world turned into the page's y-up one: a quarter turn about x. const to_y_up: Quat = .{ -0.70710678, 0.0, 0.0, 0.70710678 }; /// The free root's body - Geno's hips, the Go1's trunk - which the camera follows and the two engines are compared at. const root_body: u32 = 1; /// How one scene is looked at: how far apart its two robots are drawn, and where the camera looks from. const SceneLook = struct { /// Each robot is drawn this far from where its engine puts it, the CPU's one way and the GPU's the other. drawn_apart: Vec, camera_distance: f32, /// The height the camera looks at, above the floor. camera_height: f32, }; /// One side's colours: its rounded shapes and its flat ones. const Colours = struct { round: Color, flat: Color, }; /// The page's look, layout and motions: the colours, each scene's look, the Go1's servo and drops, the button. const Settings = struct { background: Color = .{ .r = 22, .g = 24, .b = 30, .a = 255 }, ground: Color = .{ .r = 74, .g = 80, .b = 92, .a = 255 }, title: Color = .{ .r = 230, .g = 232, .b = 238, .a = 255 }, text: Color = .{ .r = 170, .g = 176, .b = 190, .a = 255 }, /// Each side's colours - its rounded shapes, and its flat ones (boxes: Geno's feet, the Go1's trunk). cpu_colours: Colours = .{ .round = .{ .r = 120, .g = 170, .b = 225, .a = 255 }, .flat = .{ .r = 150, .g = 190, .b = 140, .a = 255 }, }, gpu_colours: Colours = .{ .round = .{ .r = 235, .g = 150, .b = 90, .a = 255 }, .flat = .{ .r = 230, .g = 190, .b = 110, .a = 255 }, }, /// Across Geno's shoulders; along the Go1's flank, its trunk lying along x. geno_look: SceneLook = .{ .drawn_apart = .{ 0.6, 0, 0, 0 }, .camera_distance = 4.2, .camera_height = 0.9 }, go1_look: SceneLook = .{ .drawn_apart = .{ 0, 0.35, 0, 0 }, .camera_distance = 1.8, .camera_height = 0.25 }, /// The floor both engines stand their robots on. floor_friction: f32 = geno.floor_friction, /// The Go1's servo: robot.zig's law at the tracking task's gains. go1_law: rbt.ServoLaw = .{ .frequency = 20, .damping = 1, .max_acceleration = 3000 }, /// How far above its home pose the Go1 is dropped from, and how many frames it is servoed before the next drop. go1_drop_height: f32 = 0.1, go1_frames_per_drop: usize = 180, /// The button that moves to the next scene, in the drawing area's logical pixels, from its lower left corner. button_width: f32 = 200, button_height: f32 = 44, button_margin: f32 = 16, button_fill: Color = .{ .r = 48, .g = 54, .b = 68, .a = 255 }, title_size: f32 = 20, text_size: f32 = 16, }; /// THE SCENES the page shows, in the order the button moves through them. const SceneKind = enum { geno_dance, go1_stand, /// The scene after this one, the last followed by the first. fn next(kind: SceneKind) SceneKind { const scene_count: usize = std.enums.values(SceneKind).len; const next_index: usize = (@backingInt(kind) + 1) % scene_count; return @fromBackingInt(@intCast(next_index)); } fn title(kind: SceneKind) []const u8 { return switch (kind) { .geno_dance => "Geno servoing the dance", .go1_stand => "The Go1 servoing to its home pose", }; } fn look(kind: SceneKind, settings: Settings) SceneLook { return switch (kind) { .geno_dance => settings.geno_look, .go1_stand => settings.go1_look, }; } }; /// A ROBOT SERVOED ON THE CPU by robot.zig's own law, a step as `ServoRun` takes it and the device does: the floor's /// contacts from the pose at the step's start, the bias forces, the servo's torques applied, the step - then the /// kinematics and the mass matrix brought forward to the new state, which the next step's servo and the drawing read. const CpuServo = struct { data: rbt.Data, /// The servo's scratches - dof_count numbers each, `dense` dof_count squared - and the torques it applies. accel_scratch: []f32, scratch: []f32, dense: []f32, full: []f32, torques: []f32, fn init(gpa: Allocator, model: *const rbt.Model) !CpuServo { const dof_count: usize = model.dof_count; const servo: CpuServo = .{ .data = try rbt.Data.init(gpa, model), .accel_scratch = try gpa.alloc(f32, dof_count), .scratch = try gpa.alloc(f32, dof_count), .dense = try gpa.alloc(f32, dof_count * dof_count), .full = try gpa.alloc(f32, dof_count), .torques = try gpa.alloc(f32, dof_count), }; return servo; } fn deinit(servo: *CpuServo, gpa: Allocator) void { gpa.free(servo.torques); gpa.free(servo.full); gpa.free(servo.dense); gpa.free(servo.scratch); gpa.free(servo.accel_scratch); servo.data.deinit(); } /// One step toward `target`, at rest there (no target velocity), on `ground`. fn step( servo: *CpuServo, model: *const rbt.Model, law: rbt.ServoLaw, target: []const f32, ground: rbt.Floor, ) !void { const data: *rbt.Data = &servo.data; data.clearContacts(); try rbt.pushFloorContacts(model, data, ground); rbt.biasForce(model, data); const dt: f32 = model.opt.timestep; rbt.servoTorques( model, data, target, null, law, null, dt, servo.accel_scratch, servo.scratch, servo.dense, servo.full, servo.torques, ); @memcpy(data.applied_joint_forces, servo.torques); rbt.step(model, data); rbt.forward(model, data); } }; /// GENO's DANCE: the copied clip, and the tracking task's own fleet following it on the CPU - one character, the /// servo alone. const GenoDance = struct { clip: dance.Clip, cpu: *track.Fleet, /// The policy's action: none, every number zero - the servo alone, so both engines aim at the reference itself. no_action: []f32, /// The clip as the device takes it (`robotgpu.ClipPoses`): its frames, each the model's coordinates - the robot /// is built from the character, so a frame is exactly its pose. Kept here, beside the clip whose frames it reads. device_clips: [1]robotgpu.ClipPoses, }; /// THE GO1 STANDING: its home pose - the model's first keyframe - and robot.zig's servo holding it on the CPU. const Go1Stand = struct { home: []f32, cpu: CpuServo, }; /// What a scene's CPU side is, and what it servos to. const Motion = union(SceneKind) { geno_dance: GenoDance, go1_stand: Go1Stand, }; /// ONE FRAME's GPU POSES IN FLIGHT: its body positions and orientations, each asked for after the GPU's step and /// collected on its own when its copy lands (each request collected once, then null), and the CPU's root at that same /// step - so the two engines are compared at one step, not the GPU's pose a frame late against the CPU's now. const PoseRequest = struct { positions: ?PoseArrayRequest, orientations: ?PoseArrayRequest, cpu_root: Vec, }; /// THE GPU's POSES as the page draws them: the request in flight, the copies landing (four floats a body), and the /// last poses to have arrived - with the CPU's root at their step. const GpuPoses = struct { in_flight: ?PoseRequest = null, positions_landing: []f32 = &.{}, orientations_landing: []f32 = &.{}, positions: []Vec = &.{}, orientations: []Quat = &.{}, /// Whether any poses have arrived yet: until then the GPU's robot is not drawn. arrived: bool = false, cpu_root_at_their_step: Vec = zm.vec_zero, /// Room for `body_count` bodies' poses, none arrived yet. fn alloc(gpa: Allocator, body_count: usize) Allocator.Error!GpuPoses { const poses: GpuPoses = .{ .positions_landing = try gpa.alloc(f32, 4 * body_count), .orientations_landing = try gpa.alloc(f32, 4 * body_count), .positions = try gpa.alloc(Vec, body_count), .orientations = try gpa.alloc(Quat, body_count), }; return poses; } /// The request in flight given up - its poses are of a world begun again since. fn dropInFlight(poses: *GpuPoses) void { const request: *PoseRequest = if (poses.in_flight) |*in_flight| in_flight else return; if (request.positions) |*positions| { positions.discard(); } if (request.orientations) |*orientations| { orientations.discard(); } poses.in_flight = null; } fn free(poses: *GpuPoses, gpa: Allocator) void { poses.dropInFlight(); gpa.free(poses.positions_landing); gpa.free(poses.orientations_landing); gpa.free(poses.positions); gpa.free(poses.orientations); } }; /// ONE SCENE: its robot's model, its CPU side and motion, its GPU world - or null where the device refused the model, /// `gpu_refusal` naming why - and the GPU's poses as they arrive. const Scene = struct { kind: SceneKind, doc: codecs.xml.Document, robot: mjcf.Robot, imported: robot_mjcf.Imported, motion: Motion, gpu: ?Sim, gpu_refusal: []const u8, gpu_poses: GpuPoses, /// The frames since this run began - Geno's frame of the clip - and how many runs have begun. frame: usize, runs: u32, }; const State = struct { gpa: Allocator, settings: Settings = .{}, font: z.Font, cam: z.OrbitCamera, cube: z.Mesh, sphere: z.Mesh, cylinder: z.Mesh, transform: [1]Mat, scene: Scene, }; /// Every kernel of robotgpu's with its WGSL, which the build translates and embeds beside this page as `<kernel>_wgsl` /// - every program's (`robotgpu.kernels`): the step's, and the decision's around it. fn kernelTable() [robotgpu.kernels.len]Pipe.KernelWgsl { var table: [robotgpu.kernels.len]Pipe.KernelWgsl = undefined; inline for (robotgpu.kernels, 0..) |name, index| { table[index] = .{ .name = name, .wgsl = @embedFile(name ++ "_wgsl") }; } return table; } /// THE GPU's ROBOT: one world of `model`, following `clips` (none for a scene without a clip), on `ground` and driven /// by the servo `law` - or null where the device refuses the model, the refusal named in `refusal`. fn makeGpu( gpa: Allocator, f: *z.Frame, model: *const rbt.Model, clips: []const robotgpu.ClipPoses, ground: rbt.Floor, law: rbt.ServoLaw, refusal: *[]const u8, ) !?Sim { const kernels: [robotgpu.kernels.len]Pipe.KernelWgsl = comptime kernelTable(); const world_count: u32 = 1; const device: wgpu.DeviceHandle = f.gpu.device; const queue: wgpu.QueueHandle = f.gpu.queue; var gpu: Sim = Sim.initGpuTracking(gpa, device, queue, &kernels, model, world_count, clips) catch |err| { refusal.* = @errorName(err); return null; }; errdefer gpu.deinit(); try gpu.setFloor(ground); gpu.setServo(law, .toward_rest); return gpu; } /// Geno's model, clip and fleet, into `scene`. The capture is read first: the model steps at the capture's frame time, /// so the physics and both servos read one timestep. fn loadGenoDance(gpa: Allocator, scene: *Scene) !void { var capture: codecs.bvh.Data = try codecs.bvh.parse(gpa, dance_bvh, null); defer capture.deinit(); scene.doc = try codecs.xml.parse(gpa, z.robot_geno_model, null); scene.robot = try mjcf.readRobot(gpa, &scene.doc); // Armature 2 on every ball: the servo's strength standing (`robot_geno.standing_armature`). for (scene.robot.joints) |*joint| { if (joint.kind == .ball) { joint.armature = geno.standing_armature; } } var options: rbt.Options = geno.physicsOptions(); options.timestep = capture.frame_time; scene.imported = try robot_mjcf.build(gpa, &scene.robot, options); var bind: geno.Posed = try geno.readPose(gpa, bind_bvh); defer bind.deinit(gpa); const clip: dance.Clip = try geno.copyClip(gpa, &scene.imported, bind, capture); scene.motion = .{ .geno_dance = .{ .clip = clip, .cpu = undefined, .no_action = undefined, .device_clips = undefined, } }; const geno_dance: *GenoDance = &scene.motion.geno_dance; assertf(clip.nq == scene.imported.model.coordinate_count, @src(), "the dance's {d} coordinates, Geno's {d}", .{ clip.nq, scene.imported.model.coordinate_count, }); geno_dance.device_clips = .{.{ .poses = geno_dance.clip.targets, .frame_count = @intCast(clip.frame_count), .frame_time = clip.frame_time, }}; // Geno's task, as training and judging see it; the fleet keeps the clip's place, which the scene holds in place. const fleet_options: track.Fleet.Options = .{ .envs = 1, .capacity = 64, .task = geno.tracking_task, // The task names bodies - the feet the floor may touch, the head it measures. .body_names = scene.imported.names, }; geno_dance.cpu = try track.Fleet.init(gpa, &scene.imported.model, &.{&geno_dance.clip}, fleet_options); geno_dance.no_action = try gpa.alloc(f32, track.actionSize(&scene.imported.model)); @memset(geno_dance.no_action, 0); } /// The Go1's model, home pose and servo, into `scene` - at the tracking task's physics. fn loadGo1Stand(gpa: Allocator, scene: *Scene) !void { scene.doc = try codecs.xml.parse(gpa, z.robot_go1_model, null); scene.robot = try mjcf.readRobot(gpa, &scene.doc); scene.imported = try robot_mjcf.build(gpa, &scene.robot, geno.physicsOptions()); const model: *const rbt.Model = &scene.imported.model; var cpu: CpuServo = try .init(gpa, model); errdefer cpu.deinit(gpa); // The home pose, the model's own: its first keyframe. if (scene.robot.keyframes.len == 0 or !robot_mjcf.applyKeyframe(model, &cpu.data, scene.robot.keyframes[0])) { return error.NoHomePose; } const home: []f32 = try gpa.dupe(f32, cpu.data.joint_positions); scene.motion = .{ .go1_stand = .{ .home = home, .cpu = cpu } }; } /// The servo law a scene's GPU side is given: the CPU side's own. fn lawOf(scene: *const Scene, settings: Settings) rbt.ServoLaw { return switch (scene.motion) { .geno_dance => |*geno_dance| geno_dance.cpu.options.task.gains.law(), .go1_stand => settings.go1_law, }; } /// The CPU side's state: what the CPU's robot is drawn from, and what the GPU's starts from. fn cpuDataOf(scene: *const Scene) *const rbt.Data { return switch (scene.motion) { .geno_dance => |*geno_dance| &geno_dance.cpu.data[0], .go1_stand => |*go1_stand| &go1_stand.cpu.data, }; } /// The clips a scene's GPU world follows, as the device takes them: Geno's dance (`GenoDance.device_clips`); none for /// the Go1, whose target the page uploads. fn clipsOf(scene: *const Scene) []const robotgpu.ClipPoses { return switch (scene.motion) { .geno_dance => |*geno_dance| &geno_dance.device_clips, .go1_stand => &.{}, }; } /// How far the CPU's hips are from where the clip has them at its frame - the servo's own tracking error. fn hipsFromClip(geno_dance: *const GenoDance) f32 { const fleet: *const track.Fleet = geno_dance.cpu; const frame: usize = @min(fleet.frame[0], geno_dance.clip.frame_count - 1); const reference: []const f32 = geno_dance.clip.pose(frame); const hips: []const f32 = fleet.data[0].joint_positions; // The free root's first three coordinates are its position. const apart: Vec = vec(hips[0] - reference[0], hips[1] - reference[1], hips[2] - reference[2]); return length3(apart); } /// The Go1 at rest `height` above its home pose - its free root raised - and brought forward to that state. fn dropGo1(model: *const rbt.Model, go1_stand: *Go1Stand, height: f32) void { const data: *rbt.Data = &go1_stand.cpu.data; data.reset(model); data.forgetWarmStart(); @memcpy(data.joint_positions, go1_stand.home); // The free root's coordinates are its position, x y z, then its orientation: the third is its height. data.joint_positions[2] += height; data.stage = .stale; rbt.forward(model, data); } /// THE GPU's WORLD BEGUN AGAIN where the CPU's robot now is: its pose and velocity, its warm start forgotten - and, /// following a clip, its frame and its filter at rest, as the fleet's `startAt` leaves its character. fn restartGpuFromCpu(scene: *Scene) void { const gpu: *Sim = if (scene.gpu) |*device_world| device_world else return; const cpu_data: *const rbt.Data = cpuDataOf(scene); gpu.uploadWorldPositions(0, cpu_data.joint_positions); gpu.uploadWorldArray("joint_velocities", 0, cpu_data.joint_velocities); gpu.forgetWarmStart(0); switch (scene.motion) { .geno_dance => |*geno_dance| { gpu.setWorldClip(0, 0, geno_dance.cpu.frame[0]); gpu.uploadWorldArray("applied_actions", 0, geno_dance.no_action); }, .go1_stand => {}, } } /// A NEW RUN of the scene, begun by the page: the CPU's robot started - Geno by the fleet at the clip's second frame, /// the first with a frame before it (`Fleet.startAt`: the frame's pose, the velocity into it from the one before, /// rested on the floor), the Go1 dropped - and the GPU's from exactly that state. fn startRun(scene: *Scene, settings: Settings) void { scene.frame = 0; scene.runs += 1; switch (scene.motion) { .geno_dance => |*geno_dance| { const first_frame_with_a_velocity: usize = 1; geno_dance.cpu.startAt(0, 0, first_frame_with_a_velocity); }, .go1_stand => |*go1_stand| dropGo1(&scene.imported.model, go1_stand, settings.go1_drop_height), } restartGpuFromCpu(scene); } /// THE SCENE `kind`, built in place - its model, its CPU side, its GPU world - and its first run begun. In place, since /// the CPU side keeps hold of the model the scene owns. fn loadScene( gpa: Allocator, f: *z.Frame, settings: Settings, kind: SceneKind, scene: *Scene, ) !void { scene.* = .{ .kind = kind, .doc = undefined, .robot = undefined, .imported = undefined, .motion = undefined, .gpu = null, .gpu_refusal = "", .gpu_poses = .{}, .frame = 0, .runs = 0, }; switch (kind) { .geno_dance => try loadGenoDance(gpa, scene), .go1_stand => try loadGo1Stand(gpa, scene), } const model: *const rbt.Model = &scene.imported.model; const ground: rbt.Floor = .{ .friction = settings.floor_friction }; const law: rbt.ServoLaw = lawOf(scene, settings); scene.gpu = try makeGpu(gpa, f, model, clipsOf(scene), ground, law, &scene.gpu_refusal); if (scene.gpu) |*gpu| { scene.gpu_poses = try GpuPoses.alloc(gpa, model.body_count); // Geno's action as the fleet takes it: its scale, and its filter's share. switch (scene.motion) { .geno_dance => |*geno_dance| { gpu.setActionScale(geno_dance.cpu.options.action_scale); const cpu_options: track.Fleet.Options = geno_dance.cpu.options; gpu.setActionFilter(cpu_options.action_filter, cpu_options.stiffness_filter); gpu.uploadWorldArray("actions", 0, geno_dance.no_action); }, .go1_stand => {}, } } startRun(scene, settings); } fn unloadScene(gpa: Allocator, scene: *Scene) void { if (scene.gpu) |*gpu| { scene.gpu_poses.free(gpa); gpu.deinit(); } switch (scene.motion) { .geno_dance => |*geno_dance| { geno_dance.cpu.deinit(); gpa.free(geno_dance.no_action); geno_dance.clip.deinit(); }, .go1_stand => |*go1_stand| { go1_stand.cpu.deinit(gpa); gpa.free(go1_stand.home); }, } scene.imported.deinit(); scene.robot.deinit(); scene.doc.deinit(); } /// One array's request collected into `destination` if its copy has landed - then null, as a request is collected /// once. A null request has landed already. fn collectArray(request: *?PoseArrayRequest, destination: []f32) void { const pending: *PoseArrayRequest = if (request.*) |*in_flight| in_flight else return; if (pending.collect(destination)) { request.* = null; } } /// THE GPU's POSES, after its step: the request in flight collected - once both its arrays have landed, they become /// the poses drawn, with the CPU's root at their step - and the next asked for, with the CPU's root at this one. Only /// one request is in flight at a time: the page draws the latest poses to arrive, however late. fn collectGpuPoses(gpa: Allocator, scene: *Scene, gpu: *Sim) !void { const poses: *GpuPoses = &scene.gpu_poses; if (poses.in_flight) |*request| { collectArray(&request.positions, poses.positions_landing); collectArray(&request.orientations, poses.orientations_landing); const both_landed: bool = request.positions == null and request.orientations == null; if (!both_landed) { return; } for (poses.positions, poses.orientations, 0..) |*position, *orientation, body| { position.* = poses.positions_landing[4 * body ..][0..4].*; orientation.* = poses.orientations_landing[4 * body ..][0..4].*; } poses.cpu_root_at_their_step = request.cpu_root; poses.arrived = true; poses.in_flight = null; } const layout: robotgpu.WorldStateLayout = gpu.layout.world_f; const number_count: u32 = 4 * gpu.counts.body_count; poses.in_flight = .{ .positions = try gpu.pipe.requestRange(gpa, .world_f, layout.body_positions.offset, number_count), .orientations = try gpu.pipe.requestRange(gpa, .world_f, layout.body_orientations.offset, number_count), .cpu_root = cpuDataOf(scene).body_positions[root_body], }; } /// GENO's FRAME: the fleet steps its character (the servo alone, aiming a frame ahead), the GPU takes one decision of /// one physics step (its targets from the clip on the device, its frame advanced there). When the fleet has begun a /// new episode - its failure rule, or the clip's end - the GPU's world begins it from the fleet's new state, and the /// poses still in flight, of the run that ended, are dropped. fn stepGenoDance(gpa: Allocator, scene: *Scene, geno_dance: *GenoDance) !void { const fleet: *track.Fleet = geno_dance.cpu; _ = fleet.step(geno_dance.no_action); scene.frame = fleet.frame[0]; const began_again: bool = fleet.dones[0]; if (began_again) { scene.runs += 1; } const gpu: *Sim = if (scene.gpu) |*device_world| device_world else return; const physics_steps: u32 = 1; gpu.submitDecision(physics_steps); if (began_again) { restartGpuFromCpu(scene); scene.gpu_poses.dropInFlight(); return; } try collectGpuPoses(gpa, scene, gpu); } /// THE GO1's FRAME: its servo toward its home pose on both engines, the page uploading the target to the GPU; dropped /// again once it has stood its frames. fn stepGo1Stand( gpa: Allocator, settings: Settings, scene: *Scene, go1_stand: *Go1Stand, ) !void { const ground: rbt.Floor = .{ .friction = settings.floor_friction }; try go1_stand.cpu.step(&scene.imported.model, settings.go1_law, go1_stand.home, ground); if (scene.gpu) |*gpu| { gpu.uploadWorldArray("servo_targets", 0, go1_stand.home); gpu.submitStep(); try collectGpuPoses(gpa, scene, gpu); } const next_frame: usize = scene.frame + 1; if (next_frame >= settings.go1_frames_per_drop) { startRun(scene, settings); return; } scene.frame = next_frame; } /// ONE FRAME OF BOTH ENGINES, the scene's own way. fn stepScene(gpa: Allocator, settings: Settings, scene: *Scene) !void { switch (scene.motion) { .geno_dance => |*geno_dance| try stepGenoDance(gpa, scene, geno_dance), .go1_stand => |*go1_stand| try stepGo1Stand(gpa, settings, scene, go1_stand), } } /// The camera set for the scene: looking at its root from the scene's distance. fn aimCamera(s: *State) void { const look: SceneLook = s.scene.kind.look(s.settings); } /// The button's place: its size, its margin from the drawing area's lower left corner. fn buttonRect(settings: Settings, f: *z.Frame) Rectangle { const button: Rectangle = .{ .x = settings.button_margin, .y = f.window.heightf() - settings.button_margin - settings.button_height, .width = settings.button_width, .height = settings.button_height, };
